stories.title: Home Office changes Gronant asylum seeker housing plan after review
stories.summary: Major changes have been made to an asylum seeker housing plan in Gronant following a Home Office review. According to Clwyd East Labour MP Becky Gittins the Home Office has reconsidered plans to house 13 migrant families at Gronant Institute while they await decisions on their asylum applications. stories.title: Two-vehicle collision closed A494 at Ewloe for 2 hours overnight
stories.summary: The A494 at Ewloe was closed for around two hours overnight after a two-vehicle collision on the eastbound carriageway. North Wales Police said officers were called just before 12.30am on Monday 17 August. stories.summary: North Wales Police are appealing for witnesses after a car was deliberately set alight on a residential street in Holywell.
